name: The Drowned Crown
text: The crown weighs your dice down, no first die reads under four.

name: The Salt Veil
text: Salt stiffens the veil, WITS and NERVE read five at the least.

name: Hood of the Sunk Watch
text: The hood sees the next stage and every TN the Blindfold hides.

name: Hauberk of the Ninth Chain
text: Nine chains on the chest, each Strike lands one lighter on you.

name: Barnacled Breastplate
text: Barnacles shut the plate, one more Armor, no contagion reaches you.

name: Shroud of the Unsunk
text: Once the shroud lifts you from the water when Strain would drown you.

name: Gauntlets of Rust and Bone
text: Rust and bone in the grip, MIGHT climbs a rung, reads three at least.

name: The Tidewright Gloves
text: Wet gloves, slick fingers, every stat surges one face sooner.

name: Grip of the Bellringer
text: Bell rope in hand, MIGHT surges sooner, each surge bites two deeper.

name: Boots of the Drowned Sentry
text: Once a quest you act and bench both, and each bench clears one more.

name: Waders of the Black Ford
text: Black water to the knee, two more on every Relay check you make.

name: Sandals of the Long Sleep
text: Sleep comes easy in these, Respite and the bench each clear one more.

name: The Drowning Hook
text: The hook drags, Aspects take one more, two more when the die surges.

name: Knucklebone of the Choir
text: A drowned knuckle, top die ones roll again, one roll a stage returns.

name: Bellows of the Deep
text: Bellows breathe for you in Hollow Air, your top stat surges sooner.

name: Chain of the Unbound
text: The chain never rusts, Rustbound passes you over, one more Toughness.

name: Lantern of the Ninth Hour
text: The wick flares at the last door, three more on every check there.

name: Bone Die of the Vault
text: A bone die kept for the Vault, three more on every Vault check.

name: Mark of the Cold Toll
text: The Toll takes no Strain from you, and two more ride your die there.

name: Satchel from the Wreck
text: The satchel from the wreck holds one more Rare relic every quest.
